description: This bar chart illustrates the token count for “Reasoning” and “Demonstration” across different numbers of shots. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Shots”, displays categories numbered 0 through 4 in sequential order, with no specified scale type. The vertical axis, labeled “Token Count”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7000, with tick labels at 1000-unit intervals. Each category has a stacked bar composed of two components: a lower, orange portion representing “Reasoning” and an upper, blue portion representing “Demonstration”. For category 0, the “Reasoning” component reaches approximately 4200, while the “Demonstration” component reaches approximately 2600. In category 1, “Reasoning” reaches approximately 4150 and “Demonstration” reaches approximately 4250. Category 2 shows “Reasoning” at approximately 4200 and “Demonstration” at approximately 2600. Category 3 shows “Reasoning” at approximately 4300 and “Demonstration” at approximately 2700. Finally, category 4 shows “Reasoning” at approximately 4150 and “Demonstration” at approximately 2600. Red arrows with numerical labels are present above each bar, indicating a negative value relative to the previous bar, with values of -1952, -1613, -1040, and -1379 for categories 1 through 4 respectively. The bars are arranged sequentially by the number of shots, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation beyond the arrows.
